verses.text: Come, let us sing for joy to the LORD; let us shout to the Rock of our salvation!

verses.text: Let us enter His presence with thanksgiving; let us make a joyful noise to Him in song.

verses.text: For the LORD is a great God, a great King above all gods.

verses.text: In His hand are the depths of the earth, and the mountain peaks belong to Him.

verses.text: The sea is His, for He made it, and His hands formed the dry land.

verses.text: O come, let us worship and bow down; let us kneel before the LORD our Maker.

verses.text: For forty years I was angry with that generation, and I said, “They are a people whose hearts go astray, and they have not known My ways.”
